items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: That was -- his name was Sammy.

ctx.x: Were you actually getting any notes out or just --
Well, not at first, but shortly, yes, I did get notes out, and I could play it, I guess, so I could play it. Then my brother brought his instrument home, the pck horn, you know --
Are you talking about Von or one of your stepbrothers?
